what: Proposed Step 3 block relies on the silent current-design-env source but adds no DESIGN_TMPDIR non-empty guard

what: Plan assumes Step 6 cleanup removes the Step 3 sentinel, but Step 6 intentionally skips cleanup on preserve paths
